reasons.claim: Notification is a small 0.42 ha polygon (Föryngringsavverkning, Mora), status 'Anmält för avverkning'; equivalent radius 37 m.
No completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%), so the site is not already felled.

One eligible species is recorded within 250 m: Alectoria sarmentosa (garnlav), VU, a site-bound lichen, forest-associated, with felling-relevant threats (lack of continuity forest, lack of large/old trees, changed stand structure and tree-species composition). Nearest record is 0 m from the polygon edge, 10 m uncertainty, year 2025; a second record at 34 m.

Two site-bound forest NT fungi were also recorded at 14 m (2025, 10 m uncertainty): Fomitopsis rosea and Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum, with threats including lack of dead wood and continuity forest. Two NT species is below the rubric's MEDIUM threshold of three, but they are supporting evidence.

Effort is adequate (216 records, 10 observation days within 1000 m; 88th percentile), and near-site recording exists (4 records inside, 16 within 250 m), so the records come from a reasonably surveyed area.

uncertainties: Records are recent and precise (2025, 10 m uncertainty), but they show the species was recorded nearby, not that it occupies the felling area today.
Only 2 observation days within 250 m, so the near-site picture rests on few visits.
Exact position of the lichen relative to the part to be felled was not examined beyond the 0 m distance to the polygon edge.
not_established: That felling would harm these species or that they are on the felled area itself.
Red List category describes extinction risk, not legal protection.
Nothing here says anything about legality of the felling or establishes biodiversity value of the stand.
next_action: Send for human ecological review before felling can begin: check the GBIF records for the Alectoria sarmentosa and the two NT fungi against the polygon boundary, and consider a field visit.
